physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the centre of the chest, the small bony plate behind the sternum where a person feels themselves to be themselves. Not the heart as a pump. The heart as a place, the quiet spot you point to when someone asks where you are. It is the body's room for being a self, the floor under the question Who am I, and it is lower than the question, older than the question, already answering it by being there.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. When the looking inward turns to looping, the chest knows first. A small constant tension behind the breastbone. The breath stops reaching the bottom of the lungs and rides high in the upper ribs. Shoulders draw in. The whole upper body holds itself like something to be defended, as if the self were a thing you had to keep inside a perimeter. This is what self-obsession feels like before it has any words. A clenching where ease should be.

The climb out is also bodily, and it is closer to softening than to effort. The sternum drops. The space behind it widens. Breath reaches the belly again without being told to. You stop bracing against your own life. Naturalness is what the chest does on its own when you forget to manage it. The card's teaching of ease is not a mood. It is what this part of the body looks like when nothing is being held.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the chest, this code answers to a single amino acid, Arginine. Arginine is the body's quiet maker of the small molecule that tells blood vessels to open and let blood through. When it is at work, the vessels relax, the channels widen, the pressure eases, and what was supposed to flow flows. It is the chemistry of letting through.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the teaching of the whole card spoken one floor lower. Ease is not a mood you arrange or a state you arrive at. It is what the body is already trying to do, all day, in every vessel, the minute you stop tightening around yourself. Naturalness has a literal floor in this. Arginine runs all the way down to it. A self that does not have to grip its own outline, because the chemistry of it is already an opening.
